system.description: This sturdy leather belt features a worn brass buckle and reinforced stitching, showing the marks of long travel and hard use. Adventurers typically use it to secure pouches, sheaths, and other gear, keeping essential items within easy reach on the road.

These rugged leather boots are built for long travel, with thick soles and reinforced stitching to withstand miles of harsh terrain. Adventurers rely on them for protection and stability, whether crossing wilderness trails, dungeon floors, or city streets.

A loose, draping garment fastened at the neck or shoulder, providing warmth and protection from wind and rain. Adventurers favor it for its practicality, concealment, and the ease with which it can be thrown over armor or travel gear.
Leather forearm guards with reinforced stitching and a lace-up closure protect against scrapes, bowstring snap, and glancing blows without the weight of metal armor.

These rugged leather gloves are well-worn and creased, offering protection from rope burn, rough surfaces, and cold weather. Adventurers rely on them for climbing, handling gear, and general travel without sacrificing dexterity.
Long, flowing wizard's robes allow easy movement and may bear symbols of arcane study. They offer little physical protection but include hidden pockets for spell components.
Simple, durable linen and wool garments for everyday labor and travel. Commoner's clothes provide basic comfort and protection while remaining inexpensive and easy to replace.
Well-made, practical garments for travel and trade, balancing comfort and durability with a respectable display of prosperity. Merchant's clothes suit traders and shopkeepers.
Sturdy, well-fitted garments reinforced with leather for long travel. Adventurer's clothes provide durability, freedom of movement, and basic protection in the field.
Finely tailored garments of quality fabric with decorative trim and refined details. Nobleman's clothes are worn at court and formal functions to display status and wealth.
